text:
mia: heads-up — noticed the new sampling toggle in Console is pretty buried under Settings > Telemetry. oncall couldn't find it during yesterday's incident :grimacing:

sam: ah yea that sucks. we intentionally hid it because it's powerful, but maybe need a discovery path for oncall.

alex: can you paste where oncall looked? we exposed `sampling.preview` in the feature flags console. path is /org/:id/settings/telemetry -> Sampling -> Advanced

jordan: when the page is hard to find, oncall fallback was to edit runtime flag via `redwoodctl` which is risky. we need a shorter flow.

mia: exact sequence: open console -> click settings -> telemetry -> scroll to bottom -> toggle. they searched 'sampling' in topbar and didn't see it.

alex: proposal: add a global 'incident controls' quick action (Ctrl+K) entry that surfaces three toggles: sampling, inspect-mode, verbose-logging. also expose an ephemeral link for oncall for 1h.

sam: :+1: love ephemeral link idea. curious about audit footprint — who toggled and why. jordan can we add a mandatory reason input on UI for ephemeral toggles?

jordan: yes. reason + optional runbook link. also require 2-minute cooldown to prevent flip-flops.

devex-bot: UI sketch uploaded https://figma.com/file/abc123/incident-quick-actions

alex: technical: backend should support temporary overrides via `sampling.overrides` table with columns: tenant_id, path, expires_at, actor, reason. quick SQL:
```
INSERT INTO sampling_overrides (tenant_id, path, expires_at, actor, reason) VALUES ('t-123', '/requests', now()+interval '1 hour', 'mia', 'prod latency spike')
```

sam: ops question — do overrides bypass the console's audit log? they must NOT.

alex: they won't. override writes an AuditEvent and emits a `override.created` telemetry event.

mia: one more: telemetry visibility — we should surface current effective sample-rate next to each route in routes table, not just in telemetry page.

jordan: +1. oncall needs per-route sample rate and recent change history. maybe small sparkline.

sam: I'll add to roadmap. can someone draft the UI copy for ephemeral toggle? keeping it short: "Temporarily increase capture for debugging. Expires in 1 hour. All actions are audited." — thoughts?

mia: sounds good. maybe end with: "Changes are visible in Audit and will alert owners."

alex: I'll spin up a PR for backend schema and event plumbing. assigning to @alex.eta EOW.

ops-bot: deployed override-service v0.3 to staging :rocket:

jordan: can we run a quick canary next week with oncall during a drill?

sam: yes — schedule drill + sign-off from security.

mia: thanks all, will follow up on UI copy and testing plan.
